nodes.text:
The waystones drink cool light, and the miles are long in both directions. I feed them when the watch allows, which is never often enough.

Bring moonbell and a measure of arcane dust, and one more stone keeps its mile through the dark season.

choices.text: What happens if a stone goes dark?

nodes.text: The mile forgets itself. Travelers wander. The wood tidies up. We prefer the stones fed.
Good. The stones will know you did it. They keep better books than the humans' banks.
